title: Reference sources (pipeline/reference.py)
description: Editions of Chinese state outlets read as originals to compare state copy against. Never an outlet, never classified, never counted, no country: China stays unmonitored.

id.description: Stable identifier, always ref_..., so it can never be an outlets.yaml id.

publisher.description: The state publisher, shared by every edition of it (xinhua, cgtn, ...).

feeds.description: RSS feeds (rss), index pages read as feeds (page), Xinhua list pages (xinhua_list) and channel pages whose story links match link_pattern (link_list).

credits.description: Signature id prefixes in pipeline/signatures.yaml that credit this publisher.

collector.description: Which collector polls and fetches it: the runner (hosted) or the relay machine (self_hosted).

page_time.description: How the article page gives its publication time, read at fetch when the listing gave a date only or nothing.

cleaner.description: Template lines stripped from the extracted body before it is stored and fingerprinted.

link_pattern.description: A regular expression an entry's link must match (index pages carry hubs and e-paper links); required for link_list.
